## 6. Function

Implement exactly this behaviour (from the reference program's documentation):

```text
Pixel arithmetic shared by the video IP models (ip/shared/pymodel): luma and chroma as the RTL computes
them, run filling, border padding, the Bayer colour of each pixel and sign extension.
```

Per function:

```text
luma: (R + 2 G + B) >> 2 per pixel.

chroma: (Y, Cb, Cr, saturation): Cb = 128 + (B - Y) >> 1, Cr = 128 + (R - Y) >> 1, |Cb - 128| + |Cr - 128|.

fill: A set bit in the last span pixels of the line (run-fill counter; span 0 or 1: the bit itself).

reflect101: a padded by r on each side, mirrored without repeating the border pixel.

clamp_pad: a padded by r on each side with copies of the border pixel.

bayer_colour: CFA colour of every pixel of an h x w RAW frame: 0 R, 1 Gr, 2 Gb, 3 B for RGGB (cfa 0); other
patterns swap the phase.

signed: The low bits of v as a two's complement number.
```
